---
description: Implement a focused SaraNajafi UI change using the existing brand and design system.
---

Implement the requested UI change in the existing SaraNajafi application.

1. Inspect the target page/component, its data flow, existing design tokens, and responsive styles before editing.
2. Preserve current product behavior and the Persian-first brand. Reuse Peyda fonts, existing components, CSS variables, and API helpers.
3. Keep RTL and mixed Persian/Latin text readable. Make controls accessible by keyboard and give them clear names, states, loading, empty, and error feedback.
4. Make the smallest complete change. Do not add a dependency or alter business data/status unless explicitly requested.
5. Inspect the rendered result at desktop and mobile sizes when a local preview is available. Respect reduced-motion preferences.
6. Run the narrowest applicable web lint/typecheck/build and report exactly what passed or could not be verified.
